highlights.title: Q3 totals reconcile within ±0.4% of the source ledger.
highlights.body: Three-quarter rollup checks against the source ledger to within 0.4%. The numbers used for the rest of this analysis are safe to forward.

highlights.title: East region revenue fell 18% QoQ, dragging the total flat.
highlights.body: East dropped from $4.2M to $3.45M while North and South held steady. Without East, the rollup would have been +6% QoQ.

highlights.title: Q4 base-case lands at $13.8M ± $0.6M (R²=0.78).
highlights.body: Linear fit on the last 9 months projects Q4 at $13.8M. R² of 0.78 makes this a planning-grade read, not a wide-error speculation.

highlights.title: East flat at $3.45M in Q4 lowers total by region's typical growth
highlights.body: Holding East at $3.45M removes its expected Q4 growth contribution; total revenue would reflect only West, North, and South performance without East's usual seasonal lift.
